name: Skeleton
description: A skeleton is a grey placeholder in the shape of content that is loading: lines of text, image blocks and avatar circles. It keeps the layout steady while data arrives.
whenToUse: When loading content whose layout is known: lists, cards, profiles.

whenNotToUse.text: For a short action like saving.

values.meaning: A block; set width and height.

states.name: Shimmering
states.meaning: A light sweep; static for reduced motion.

behavior.text: Skeletons are hidden. Set aria-busy="true" on the region and announce loading once (e.g. a Spinner or status text).
Match the real content’s size so nothing jumps when it arrives.

content: Mirror the real layout; don’t add placeholder text.

guidelines.do: Match the size of the real content.
guidelines.dont: Use one generic block for every layout.
guidelines.why: Matching shapes prevent layout shift when content loads.

guidelines.dont: Leave screen reader users with an empty region.
Leave skeletons up after an error.
guidelines.why: Replace them with the content or an error message.

examples.title: Card
examples.code: import { Skeleton } from '@ds/react';

examples.title: Person

related.relation: For unknown layouts or short waits.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description:
A placeholder in the shape of content that is loading. Hidden from screen readers: mark the
loading region with aria-busy and announce loading once (e.g. with a Spinner).

variant.description: `text` lines (default), a `rect` block such as an image, or a `circle` such as an avatar.

lines.description: Number of text lines; the last is shorter.

width.description: Width, e.g. "60%" or 120 (px). Text defaults to full width.

height.description: Height of a rect or circle, e.g. 160 (px).

--skeleton-bg-color.description: Tone ramp for palettes and data; flips in dark mode so 100 is always the subtlest.

--skeleton-border-radius.description: Small rounding for tiny elements: checkboxes, tags.

--skeleton-duration.description: One turn of a repeating animation, e.g. a loading spinner.
